description: This PHP class `ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams` defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering claim request search results within the OrangeHRM system. It includes various filtering criteria such as employee inclusion options, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date range, along with default sorting behavior.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters when querying claim requests, with preset filter options and sorting behavior.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current setting for employee inclusion filter.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the employee inclusion filter option.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Retrieves the current reference ID filter.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status filter for the claim requests.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter, adjusting the time to 23:59:59 for precision.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
